description: Potpuni popis UN/LOCODE kodova za Hrvatsku. All 403 UN/LOCODE entries for Croatia from the UNECE United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations: LOCODE, place name (with and without diacritics), subdivision, function classifiers (sea port, rail, road, airport, postal, multimodal), approval status, IATA code and coordinates. Function legend embedded per record; status codes per UNECE status-indicators table.
